headline: EV Battery as Health Bar Drift Challenge
text:
A drift game where your EV battery is your health bar. Off-road drains it 90x faster; regen braking saves you.

Real weight transfer physics in a single HTML file (0.1s load).

Beat the Friday dev ghost: https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second seamless gameplay GIF showing a tight weight-transfer slide around a snowy hairpin corner with the regen battery meter flashing green, narrowly dodging oncoming traffic.
